items.name: Check Plan Import
items.warningText: BCD/timer boot-path changes can cause boot loops, black screens, or resume failure.
riskNotes: Can break startup, resume, hibernate, or wake paths and may force recovery mode.
Can trigger BSOD on unsupported driver, firmware, or interrupt-routing combinations.
items.rollbackNotes: Export current BCD before apply and rollback from recovery if normal boot fails.
